item.title: Israel's special relationship with US 'seems to have melted into a pretty bad break-up'
item.description: Donald Trump said on Wednesday that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin ​Netanyahu could use a "softer touch" in the fight against Hezbollah militants in Lebanon, the U.S. president's latest public rebuke to his partner in the war on Iran. Reporting from Jerusalem, FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky explains that the Israeli-American 'special relationship' "seems to have melted into a pretty bad break-up over the last few days".

item.title: Israeli strikes on Lebanon likely to continue 'until we get any clarity' on US-Iran agreement
item.description: Israeli forces carried out airstrikes on several areas in south Lebanon on June 17 despite an agreement on a peace deal in the Middle East war that includes Lebanon. But the contents of the deal have yet to be revealed, although the US has confirmed Israel will not have to withdraw to the international border with Lebanon. FRANCE 24's Noga Tarnopolsky tells us more from Jerusalem.

item.title: Iran war 'has been a strategic disaster for the State of Israel', analyst says
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is on a collision course with Donald Trump as the US president seeks to extricate himself from the Iran war, with both men's goals unmet and Israeli military operations tied down in Lebanon. Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Aaron David Miller, senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, says that "this has been a strategic disaster for the state of Israel. item.title: What we know about the US-Iran memorandum of understanding
item.description: The United States and Iran, ⁠as well as mediator Pakistan, ​have provided few details about the preliminary deal announced Sunday to bring an end to the US-Iran conflict that has engulfed the region and threatened global energy supplies.

item.title: Israel to stay ‘indefinitely’ in lands seized in Gaza, Lebanon and Syria
item.description: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said on Monday that Israeli ground forces would remain in land they hold in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza, potentially challenging a memorandum of understanding announced a day earlier between the US and Iran to end the war in the Middle East.

item.title: הסכם נועצים בין ארה"ב לאיראן מעלה זעם בישראל, ומפקדיו יוצאים נגד נתניהו
item.description: ישראלים מכל הספקטרום הפוליטי הגיבו בעצבנות לחדשות ההסכם, וקראו לו "מזחל" לישראל.

item.title: איראן: הסכם לסוף מלחמה עם ארצות הברית תלוי בנטישת ישראל מלבנון
item.description: שר החוץ של איראן אמר כי ההסכם הדחוק לסוף המלחמה עם ארצות הברית יתנאל בנטישת ישראל מלבנון – תנאי שישראל דחתה כבר, ואשר עלול לערער את ההסכם ולהחמיר את המלחמה.

item.title: 'Gwynocide': Could Gwyneth Paltrow be cancelled over her Israeli real estate ad?
item.description: PRESS REVIEW – Monday, June 15: Papers discuss the US-Iran "truce of convenience". According to the Israeli paper Haaretz, Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu is humiliated by Donald Trump. The US president has just turned 80, but is "really uncomfortable with ageing". Finally, could Gwyneth Paltrow get cancelled? Many people hope so.

item.description: מאחר שהודיעו האמריקאים וישראל על הסכם, רבים בדרום-לבנון מעדיפים לשוב.

item.title: הסכם עם איראן: טראמפ חוזר למקומו, אבל הקלפים נעשו בעדו
item.description: החתימה על ההסכם, שנחתם ב-14 ביוני, יום הולדתו של טראמפ, זכה לשבחים.
